blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Police arrested two men and seized two pistols and prohibited drugs from them on Thursday night, Nov. 19, in Pigcawayan, North Cotabato. The arrest came after a brief pursuit operation in Barangay Midpapan 1, Pigcawayan, North Cotabato.
